'''D-LZ8''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. After [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] was successfully rescued from [[Toborro]], several other [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] abandoned Toborro and pleaded the Republic to take them on [[the Ark]] to escape [[Makeb]]'s imminent destruction. D-LZ8 assisted in negotiations between the Hutts and [[Shalim Avesta]] by providing translation services.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
D-LZ8 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion, added to the game with Update 2.0.
